# sharpens

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sharpens`](gmeow-sharpens.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sharpens>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

S1 sharpens S2: every precisification S1 admits is also admitted by S2, so S1 is the more specific frame (the standpoint ⊆ / refinement relation of [`Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) Logic; CKR's coverage relation). Transitive. Every standpoint sharpens [`gmeow:universalStandpoint`](../individuals/gmeow-universalStandpoint.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) -> [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:sharpens`](gmeow-sharpens.md) from [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) to [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to order two standpoints by precisification — when one frame is a strict refinement of another (every precisification it admits is admitted by the broader frame), building the standpoint poset whose top is [`gmeow:universalStandpoint`](../individuals/gmeow-universalStandpoint.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as a ranking that picks a winner — sharpening is containment, not preference, and the broader frame is not 'more true' than the sharper one; competing, incomparable standpoints simply both sharpen the universal standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:sharpens`](gmeow-sharpens.md) from the more specific standpoint to the broader one and let transitivity build the poset; anchor every standpoint to [`gmeow:universalStandpoint`](../individuals/gmeow-universalStandpoint.md) at the top, and let a Standpoint-Logic reasoner read □/◊ entailments across the refinement order.
